scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nba-performance-explorer/contracts && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
